description:
WHM API 1 functions in the documented cPanel Support Tickets group.

Observed: The PR65 reviewer called getSupportAgreement(), getSupportInfo(), whitelistCheck() and list() through WHM GET on 11.138.0.19 with this client's stateless token authentication. All four raised ApiErrorException: "The system failed to restore the saved session." These failed reads establish no successful payload compatibility. All ten POST methods remain unobserved.

Documented: The pinned URL examples use /cpsess##########/json-api/, agreement and support-info reads require a cPanelID token in the current session, and validateOauth2Code() stores the validated token on the current session.

Inference: A WHM session appears to be required, based on the reviewer's reading of the failure and source text; the session code path was not traced. This is not a universal authentication diagnosis. The client has no session or cookie handling. It remains uncertain whether validateOauth2Code() could succeed yet leave no reusable session for later calls.

Policy: Keep these typed contracts available with this compatibility limit; no session management, automatic retry or inferred success is added. Session compatibility and all unobserved methods remain open under whm-api-client-8x0.2.53.
